messages:
courtney: FYI saw a sudden jump in SAST noise on staging after the RBAC tidy this morning. Lots of exec/tmp warnings under infra/ and tools/.Anyone touch service-account bindings? :grimacing:
mike: I touched infra role bindings at 08:47 UTC moving SAs to infra-admins group. Could be me.
kms-bot: Cloud KMS deny detected: 2026-03-21T08:49:12Z protoPayload.methodName=\"cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access\" status.code=7 principalEmail=\"staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"
anna: That matches logs I pulled. When KMS decrypt fails, some build steps fall back to writing a temp file which trips our exec-path/temp-file SAST rules.
courtney: Plan: 1) short rebind of KMS decrypt to the SA 2) create timeboxed suppression on staging infra/* while we collect evidence 3) re-run SAST and attach pre/post artifacts. Who can approve suppression?
mike: I can rebind now. Command ready: gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build-key --member=serviceAccount:staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
anna: Rebind applied at 08:56:03Z. gcloud output: "Updated IAM policy." I extracted KMS denies with: gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"staging-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7" --limit=50 --format=json > kms-deny-5401234567.json
sec-bot: Suppression created by courtney: pattern=infra/* env=staging duration=90m reason="temporary while KMS decrypt restored". Ticket=SEC-2572
courtney: Opened SEC-2572 and attached PR diff (the RBAC change), KMS log extract, and the failing scan id (sast-stg-2026-03-21-09). Can someone trigger a manual SAST re-run?
mike: Triggering sast-manual-540 now.
sec-bot: sast-manual-540 complete: findings from 58 -> 6. Major noisy hits cleared.
courtney: Nice. Action items: remove suppression after confirmation, add RBAC checklist item for KMS perms, and add a premerge smoke that simulates KMS deny to catch fallback paths. I'll schedule a 10-minute follow-up on tomorrow's sec-sync.
anna: Adding the checklist as a required infra PR template checkbox now.
mike: Sorry for the churn. Closing loop when suppression removed and final artifacts uploaded to SEC-2572.
